s01-1.old: Stay with the worried children and help them feel safe while they wait
s01-1.new: Keep the waiting children calm and busy, even if you miss the repair
s01-1.why: Lowers the emotive 'worried children' pull (rated 5); adds a cost so it is not the default kind answer.

s01-2.old: Track the tides and wind to work out why it stalled
s01-2.new: Work out from tides and wind why it stalled, though the answer may come too late
s01-2.why: adds a trade-off so it is not the only card with a cost; keeps the investigating activity.

s01-3.old: Open the ferry's engine and fix what is broken
s01-3.new: Open the engine and fix it, with oily hands and no one to ask for help
s01-3.why: adds a trade-off so it is not the only card with a cost; keeps hands-on repair.

s01-4.old: Paint a bright welcome board for the waiting crowd
s01-4.new: Paint a big board so the crowd knows what is happening, with an hour to finish
s01-4.why: Raises appeal (rated 3) by giving the board a purpose for the crowd; adds time pressure as the trade-off.

s02-1.old: Find out how old arches stay up, and why this one cracked
s02-1.new: Find out why this arch cracked, even if it takes all night of measuring
s02-1.why: adds a trade-off so it is not the only card with a cost.

s02-2.old: Imagine a bridge shape unlike any other
s02-2.new: Sketch a new arch shape that might be safer, though most first ideas get thrown out
s02-2.why: Was vague and off-task; now tied to the cracked arch, with a realistic cost.

s02-3.old: Take charge of the budget and the team for the repair
s02-3.new: Take charge of the repair team and the money, and face the blame if it goes wrong
s02-3.why: Replaces adult word 'budget'; adds accountability as trade-off.

s02-4.old: Fit the new planks exactly as the plan shows
s02-4.new: Fit the new planks by hand in the cold, getting every joint tight before midnight
s02-4.why: Was passive ('exactly as the plan shows', rated 2); now skilled, physical work with a cost.

s03-1.old: Study the pattern of missed chimes to find the cause
s03-1.new: Study the pattern of missed chimes, though it may take days to spot the cause
s03-1.why: adds a trade-off so it is not the only card with a cost.

s03-2.old: Climb the tower and follow the broken gear by hand
s03-2.new: Climb the tower and follow the broken gear by hand, in a dusty, cramped space
s03-2.why: adds a trade-off so it is not the only card with a cost.

s03-3.old: Start a repair log and list who does which job
s03-3.new: Plan the repair step by step so nothing is missed, while others do the climbing
s03-3.why: Was paperwork-and-bossy (rated 2); now organising with a visible purpose and a cost.

s03-4.old: Decorate the clock face with something that makes people smile
s03-4.new: Repaint the clock face so it is easier to read, even if some liked the old one
s03-4.why: Was off-task decoration; now useful design work with a social cost.

s05-1.old: Welcome the lost travellers and get them moving together
s05-1.new: Gather the lost travellers and keep their spirits up on a long, cold walk
s05-1.why: Removes 'Welcome the ...' stem that repeats across helping cards; adds cost.

s05-2.old: Mend the signal lamp so travellers can see it
s05-2.new: Mend the dim signal lamp alone on the ridge, in freezing wind
s05-2.why: Was the obvious crisis fix (rated 5); keeps repair but adds solitude and discomfort.

s05-3.old: Map where the fog is thickest and find out why
s05-3.new: Map where the fog is thickest to find a safer path, standing still in the cold
s05-3.why: Was purposeless next to the crisis; now useful for travellers, with a cost.

s05-4.old: Count everyone through the pass and keep the line in order
s05-4.new: Count everyone through the pass so no one is left behind, even as people grow impatient
s05-4.why: Gives counting a clear purpose (safety) to lift appeal; adds cost.

s06-1.old: Set your prices and persuade each visitor to take home your best item
s06-1.new: Set prices and win over buyers, knowing some will walk away
s06-1.why: Shortened (was 70 chars); softens pushy 'persuade each visitor'; adds rejection as cost.

s06-2.old: Sort the stock by size and label every shelf
s06-2.new: Sort the stock and label shelves so buyers find things fast, before the doors open
s06-2.why: Was chore-like (rated 2); now has a payoff and time pressure.

s06-3.old: Build a sturdy stall frame from the plan
s06-3.new: Build a sturdy stall frame from the plan, working fast as the light fades
s06-3.why: adds a trade-off so it is not the only card with a cost.

s06-4.old: Examine the strange old machine and work out what it was for
s06-4.new: Examine the old machine to learn its use, even if the stall opens without you
s06-4.why: Setup primes the machine; adds a real cost to temper it. Setup text should also be neutralised (not in scope).

s07-1.old: Sketch a boat unlike any you have seen
s07-1.new: Draw up a boat for the crossing that may not float the first time
s07-1.why: Was off-task and repeated the 'unlike any' stem of s02; now on-task with risk of failure.

s07-2.old: Lead the camp meeting and make sure everyone is heard
s07-2.new: Run the camp meeting and push for a decision, even if some people are unhappy
s07-2.why: 'Make sure everyone is heard' leaned toward helping; now clearly leading, with a cost.

s07-3.old: Look after the tired travellers and help them get going again
s07-3.new: Care for the tired travellers through the night while others plan the crossing
s07-3.why: Most virtuous card (rated 5); adds what you give up.

s07-4.old: Build a raft and test which wood floats best
s07-4.new: Build a raft from whatever wood is nearby, with sore arms and wet feet
s07-4.why: Removed 'test which wood floats best', which mixed in investigating; adds physical cost.

s08-1.old: Check every roll of cloth and store it in order
s08-1.new: Track the cloth rolls so none go missing before market day, a slow, careful job
s08-1.why: Was chore-like (rated 2); now has a stake (market day) and an honest cost; drops 'every ... in order' stem.

s08-2.old: Repair the loom so it runs smoothly again
s08-2.new: Repair the creaking loom, crawling under it with tools for hours
s08-2.why: adds a trade-off so it is not the only card with a cost.

s08-3.old: Coach a shy weaver to show their work with pride
s08-3.new: Coach a nervous new weaver, even though progress is slow and they may give up
s08-3.why: Was strongly virtue-coded ('with pride', rated 5); adds a realistic frustration.

s08-4.old: Design a pattern that tells the town's story
s08-4.new: Design a banner pattern for the town, knowing not everyone will like it
s08-4.why: adds a trade-off so it is not the only card with a cost.

s09-1.old: Sit and watch the cliff light shift, and capture it in a drawing
s09-1.new: Capture the cliff's changing light in drawings, even if it means climbing last
s09-1.why: 'Sit and watch' read as idle (rated 2); now active, with a cost.

s09-2.old: Split the climbers into teams and set the timetable
s09-2.new: Split the climbers into teams and set the pace, taking the blame if anyone is late
s09-2.why: adds a trade-off so it is not the only card with a cost.

s09-3.old: Rope down the cliff and test the rock as you go
s09-3.new: Rope down a short stretch to test the rock, which is slow, tiring work
s09-3.why: Was the brave-hero card (rated 5); keeps it physical but less heroic, adds cost.

s09-4.old: Go through the safety checklist, harness by harness, before anyone climbs
s09-4.new: Check every harness against the safety list while others start climbing first
s09-4.why: Shortened (was 73 chars); adds what you give up.

s10-1.old: Help a lost trader find their family
s10-1.new: Calm the gathering crowd and listen to each person's worry, which takes a while
s10-1.why: Old card was not in the setup and was rescue-coded (rated 5); now matches the setup (crowd).

s10-2.old: Weigh and record every sack, then pack the cart
s10-2.new: Weigh and record what salt is left, a fiddly job with the crowd shouting nearby
s10-2.why: Was chore-like (rated 2); now tied to the spill, with an honest cost.

s10-3.old: Settle the argument with a deal both traders accept
s10-3.new: Settle the argument with a deal both traders accept, though neither is fully happy
s10-3.why: adds a trade-off so it is not the only card with a cost.

s10-4.old: Haul the barrels and stack them so they stay put
s10-4.new: Haul the salt sacks off the road and stack them, heavy work in the heat
s10-4.why: Fixes 'barrels' vs spilled salt mismatch; adds cost.

s13-1.old: Proofread every page and keep the print run on time
s13-1.new: Proofread each page and keep the print run on time, with little praise if it goes well
s13-1.why: Was chore-like (rated 2); adds honest trade-off; drops 'every'.

s13-2.old: Pitch a new newspaper, with a plan and a price
s13-2.new: Start a new newspaper and find people to pay for it, at the risk it does not sell

s13-3.old: Investigate how the old press makes its mark
s13-3.new: Investigate how the old press works, reading faded notes that may lead nowhere
s13-3.why: 'Makes its mark' was figurative; adds cost.

s13-4.old: Design a new letter style and see if people can read it
s13-4.new: Design a new letter style for the press, then redo it if people can't read it
s13-4.why: adds a trade-off so it is not the only card with a cost.

s14-1.old: Sit with the patients and comfort them through the night
s14-1.new: Sit up with the sick travellers and comfort them, missing a night's sleep

s14-2.old: Count the medicine store and put it in perfect order
s14-2.new: Sort the medicine store so the right dose is quick to find, checking label after label
s14-2.why: 'Perfect order' sounded fussy (rated 2); now has a clear patient benefit and an honest cost.

s14-3.old: Test the water supply to find what is making people ill
s14-3.new: Test the water to find what is making people ill, with many tests that show nothing

s14-4.old: Lead the clinic team and decide who is seen first
s14-4.new: Lead the clinic team and choose who is seen first, even when someone has to wait
s14-4.why: adds a trade-off so it is not the only card with a cost.

s15-1.old: Welcome the visitors and help the shy ones join in
s15-1.new: Greet newcomers and help them join in, staying by the gate while the fun starts
s15-1.why: Removes 'Welcome the visitors' stem and 'shy ones' virtue cue; adds cost.

s15-2.old: Keep the permits, timings and checklists in order
s15-2.new: Keep the timetable so every act starts on time, working out of sight all evening
s15-2.why: Was a noun list with adult word 'permits' (rated 2); now an action with a purpose and a cost.

s15-3.old: Run the festival: the stalls, the prices and the plan
s15-3.new: Run the stalls and set the prices, then face the stallholders if sales are slow
s15-3.why: adds a trade-off so it is not the only card with a cost.

s15-4.old: Create the welcome arch with a story in its design
s15-4.new: Create the welcome arch, though you may still be painting it as the lamps arrive
s15-4.why: adds a trade-off so it is not the only card with a cost.
